nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Đổi kích thước sơ đồ SmartArt trong mục “What Are the Business Applications of Social Media?” thành cao 2" (5.08 cm) và rộng 6" (15.24 cm).
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Resize the SmartArt graphic in the “What Are the Business Applications of Social Media?” section to 2" (5.08 cm) high and 6" (15.24 cm) wide.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn SmartArt (viền ngoài).  2) Format > Size: Height = 2"; Width = 6".
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the SmartArt (outer border).  2) Format > Size: Height = 2"; Width = 6".

cham.de_bai: Resize the SmartArt graphic in the “What Are the Business Applications of Social Media?” section to 2" (5.08 cm) high and 6" (15.24 cm) wide.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Planning Content”, chuyển đoạn văn phân tách bằng tab bắt đầu bằng “Platform” thành bảng 2 cột. Giữ kiểu AutoFit mặc định.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Planning Content” section, convert the tab-delimited text that starts with “Platform” to a two-column table. Accept the default AutoFit behavior.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn các dòng văn bản phân cách bằng Tab (bắt đầu từ "Platform").  2) Insert > Table > Convert Text to Table.  3) Number of columns: 2; Separate text at: Tabs; giữ AutoFit mặc định (Fixed column width: Auto) > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the tab-separated lines (starting with "Platform").  2) Insert > Table > Convert Text to Table.  3) Number of columns: 2; Separate text at: Tabs; keep the default AutoFit (Fixed column width: Auto) > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the “Planning Content” section, convert the tab-delimited text that starts with “Platform” to a two-column table. Accept the default AutoFit behavior.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Planning Content”, áp dụng hiệu ứng nghệ thuật Paint Brush cho ảnh.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Planning Content” section, apply the Paint Brush artistic effect to the picture.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn ảnh.  2) Picture Format > Artistic Effects > Paint Brush.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the picture.  2) Picture Format > Artistic Effects > Paint Brush.

cham.de_bai: In the “Planning Content” section, apply the Paint Brush artistic effect to the picture.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De09_P7_Library_Expert.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới. File phụ (ảnh, dữ liệu, 3D Models) nằm cùng thư mục bài làm.
du_an.mo_ta_en: Open De09_P7_Library_Expert.docx and complete the tasks below in order. Extra files (pictures, data, 3D Models) are in the same work folder.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Borrowing Books”, bên trong cặp ngoặc sau chữ “see”, chèn tham chiếu chéo (cross-reference) tới Table 1. Chỉ hiển thị nhãn và số.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Borrowing Books” section, inside the parentheses after the text “see”, insert a cross-reference to Table 1. Display only the label and number.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ sau chữ "see " trong ngoặc.  2) References > Cross-reference.  3) Reference type: Table; Insert reference to: Only label and number; chọn Table 1 > Insert > Close.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Put the cursor after "see " inside the parentheses.  2) References > Cross-reference.  3) Reference type: Table; Insert reference to: Only label and number; choose Table 1 > Insert > Close.

cham.de_bai: In the “Borrowing Books” section, inside the parentheses after the text “see”, insert a cross-reference to Table 1. Display only the label and number.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Giới hạn chỉnh sửa để người dùng chỉ được chèn comment. Bật bảo vệ (Start Enforcing Protection) không đặt mật khẩu.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Restrict editing of the document so that users can only insert comments. Start enforcing protection without a password.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Review > Restrict Editing.  2) Editing restrictions: tích Allow only this type of editing in the document > chọn Comments.  3) Yes, Start Enforcing Protection > để trống hai ô mật khẩu > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Review > Restrict Editing.  2) Editing restrictions: check Allow only this type of editing in the document > choose Comments.  3) Yes, Start Enforcing Protection > leave both password boxes empty > OK.

cham.de_bai: Restrict editing of the document so that users can only insert comments. Start enforcing protection without a password.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong đoạn trống sau tiêu đề "List of Tables", chèn danh mục bảng biểu (table of figures) dựa trên các chú thích Table. Dùng định dạng Formal.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the blank paragraph after the "List of Tables" heading, insert a table of figures that references the Table captions. Use the Formal format.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ vào đoạn trống dưới "List of Tables".  2) References > Insert Table of Figures.  3) Caption label: Table; Formats: Formal > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Put the cursor in the blank paragraph under "List of Tables".  2) References > Insert Table of Figures.  3) Caption label: Table; Formats: Formal > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the blank paragraph after the "List of Tables" heading, insert a table of figures that references the Table captions. Use the Formal format.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Tạo character style tên “Brand Name” gồm chữ đậm, màu Green. Áp dụng style này cho đoạn chữ “Story time takes place every Saturday morning.”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Create a character style named “Brand Name” that uses bold, Green font color. Apply the style to the text “Story time takes place every Saturday morning.”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn câu văn.  2) Styles pane > New Style.  3) Name: Brand Name; Style type: Character; Bold; Font color: Green > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the sentence.  2) Styles pane > New Style.  3) Name: Brand Name; Style type: Character; Bold; Font color: Green > OK.

cham.de_bai: Create a character style named “Brand Name” that uses bold, Green font color. Apply the style to the text “Story time takes place every Saturday morning.”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Tạo bộ theme fonts tùy chỉnh tên “Library Fonts”, dùng Cambria cho tiêu đề và Calibri cho nội dung.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Create a custom theme font set named “Library Fonts” that uses Cambria as the heading font and Calibri as the body font.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Design > Fonts > Customize Fonts.  2) Heading font: Cambria; Body font: Calibri; Name: Library Fonts > Save.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Design > Fonts > Customize Fonts.  2) Heading font: Cambria; Body font: Calibri; Name: Library Fonts > Save.

cham.de_bai: Create a custom theme font set named “Library Fonts” that uses Cambria as the heading font and Calibri as the body font.
